question: How do I redirect all pages from an old folder structure to a new one while preserving nested paths?
ground_truth: To redirect all pages from an old folder structure to a new one while preserving nested paths, use regex-based redirects with the asterisk (*) parameter. In your docs.yml file, add a redirect like: source: "/old-folder/:slug*" destination: "/new-folder/:slug*". The :slug* parameter matches multiple segments (e.g., /old-folder/foo/bar/baz) and preserves the entire nested structure in the destination.

metadata.cited_context: Regex-based redirects can be used with parameters suffixed with an asterisk (*) to match zero or more path segments. The example shows: source: "/old-folder/:slug*" destination: "/new-folder/:slug*" which matches multiple segments like /old-folder/foo/bar/baz and redirects to /new-folder/foo/bar/baz, preserving the entire folder structure.
